fix_summary: TTLCache.get() returns cached values without checking whether the entry has expired. Compare the current time against the stored timestamp and self.ttl_seconds; if expired, delete the entry and return None. For example: in get(), after unpacking stored_at, value, check if time.monotonic() - stored_at >= self.ttl_seconds; if so, remove the key and return None; otherwise return value.
suggested_test: Create a TTLCache with ttl_seconds=1, put a key, assert get(key) returns the value immediately, sleep for >1s, then assert get(key) returns None. Also verify that after expiration, a subsequent put updates the value and get returns the new value.
